notes: Idea: item response theory as a browser tool (explore). Overlap check: open PR #16865 scale-reliability covers alpha/omega (classical); this is the model-based side and does not duplicate it. Verification: 1PL on LSAT matches every digit ltm prints in Rizopoulos 2006 (JSS 17(5)): b, SE(b), a=0.7551 (0.0694), logLik -2466.938, AIC 4945.875, BIC 4975.322; 2PL logLik -2466.65, LRT 0.57/4 df p=0.967. girth 0.8.0 agrees within 0.0002 (LSAT) and 0.004 (simulated). Simulation (60 x 20 items x 1000): coverage a 95.1%, b 95.5%, S-X2 false alarms 5.1% of 1,140; guessing-item power only 7/60; LR test under 1PL truth rejected 0/60 (p-values roughly uniform, mean 0.48). SAT12: distractor table flags Q32 answer 3 (mirt docs say key 5 should be 3); rescored a 0.12 -> 0.47. All 7 DOIs checked against Crossref. 36 venture tests pass; page checked in Chromium at 390 px (no console errors, no overflow); venture-preflight rerun after fixes (output summary in PR). Next: graded/partial-credit items, 3PL with prior, DIF.
